# ISSUE-05: Build Health Vitals Tracking & Visualization (Recharts)

## Description
Implement a tracking system for patient vitals (Weight, Blood Pressure, Heart Rate) featuring interactive charts to help patients and doctors monitor health trends.

## Tasks
- [ ] Implement `vitalsService.js` on backend.
- [ ] Add `POST` and `GET` endpoints for vitals data.
- [ ] Install and integrate `recharts` on the frontend.
- [ ] Build the `VitalsHub.jsx` visualization component.
